subject: s14ForeignDeleteUnreached
why: the helper goroutine deletes the next key in cyclic order after the first production, handshake-ordered: the deleted key is unreached and never produced — admitted set {112, 1012, 1102} by which key came first (members=3; gc exhibits all three, plain and -race)

subject: s14ForeignInsert
why: the helper goroutine creates key 4 after the first production, handshake-ordered: produced or skipped — admitted set {1110, 1111} (members=2; gc exhibits both at the lane's probe — the skipped member in 27/200 plain and 16/100 -race runs — but rarely within the harness's 32 draws)

subject: s14ForeignUpdateUnreached
why: the helper goroutine sets the two unreached entries to 100 after the first production, handshake-ordered: their productions read the live values — admitted set {2013, 2023, 2033} by the first value (members=3; gc exhibits all three, plain and -race)

subject: s14RangeOnGoroutine
why: the range runs on a spawned goroutine, deleting the current key and creating k+10 for each start key: each created entry may be produced (then deleted, creating nothing) or skipped — admitted set {33, 42, 51, 60} as n*10 + len (members=4; gc exhibits 33: the created keys take the freed slots behind its cursor)

subject: s14ForeignReads
why: an index read and len by the other goroutine during the range with NO synchronisation beyond the final receive: every access of the ranging goroutine's picks is a READ, so no schedule is a race and every schedule yields 64 — a per-pick footprint recorded as a write would refuse this row
